note: Morpheme make-up per verb, derived from the paradigms in verbs.json and safe to hand-correct. "root" is the lexical core, "roots" holds stem variants (aorist ablaut and the like), "pfsf" the present/future stem formant, "preverbs" the preverbs this verb takes and "preverbScreeves" the screeves that carry them, "version" the usual preradical vowel. "parsed" is the share of forms the segmenter split cleanly and "check" marks the ones worth a human eye. Regenerate with: node scripts/buildVerbMorphemes.cjs
